title: Claim semantics derive checkpoint strength
problem: A strong endpoint can bypass strong barriers if it self-labels as a weaker claim class.
kernel_rule: The certificate's declared claim_type must equal the strongest type derived from structured endpoint semantics; mismatch blocks authority.
invariants: Barrier Strength Must Follow What The Claim Does, Not What It Calls Itself
Reachability Semantics Cannot Be Downgraded To Descriptive By Relabeling
boundary: Structured semantic flags can themselves be misdeclared; production use should bind them to the claim-construction operation or an independently auditable semantic classifier.
